author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: passage/বাক্যটিকে Indirect Speech-এ রূপান্তর করো (Test Paper থেকে সংগৃহীত, 7 marks)।

items.original: The teacher said to the students, "Why are you making a noise? Keep quiet."
a: The teacher asked the students why they were making a noise and told them to keep quiet.
The teacher asked the students why they were making a noise and ordered them to keep quiet.
items.rule_bn: Wh-প্রশ্ন + আদেশ: asked why ... were, and told/ordered to keep quiet।

items.original: The old man said, "May you live long, my son."
a: The old man prayed that his son might live long.
The old man wished that his son might live long.

items.original: He said to me, "Let us go for a walk."
a: He proposed to me that we should go for a walk.
He suggested that we should go for a walk.

items.original: Mother said to me, "May Allah bless you."
a: Mother prayed that Allah might bless me.

items.original: The stranger said, "Alas! I am undone."
a: The stranger exclaimed with sorrow that he was undone.
items.rule_bn: Exclamatory (Alas): exclaimed with sorrow that; I→he, am→was।

items.original: He said to them, "Do you know the way to the station?"
a: He asked them if they knew the way to the station.
He asked them whether they knew the way to the station.
items.rule_bn: Yes/No প্রশ্ন: asked if/whether; do you know→they knew।

items.original: The father said to his son, "Never tell a lie."
a: The father advised his son never to tell a lie.
The father warned his son never to tell a lie.
items.rule_bn: উপদেশ/নিষেধ: advised + never to + base verb।

items.original: He said, "How clever the boy is!"
a: He exclaimed with wonder that the boy was very clever.
items.rule_bn: Exclamatory (How): exclaimed with wonder that; how clever→very clever।
